document.note: PDF document. Standard input for PDFDownloadLink and BlobProvider; also accepted by PDFViewer.

children.note: Viewer Document or download/status HTML UI. Legacy Document children are accepted only without document.

height.note: Preview height in pixels or CSS length. Default: 700.

showToolbar.note: Show floating page controls, or native browser toolbar hint. Default: true.

style.note: CSS styles on the HTML container (viewer/provider) or download anchor.

render.note: Named function producing DOM UI from {loading, error, url, size, data}.

previewMode.note: Preview style. Default: playground; native uses the browser PDF viewer.

pageNumber.note: Controlled preview page, starting at 1. Default: 1.

frameId.note: Stable iframe DOM ID, replacing a non-serializable innerRef.

showDownload.note: Include a download link with a preview. Default: true.

fonts.note: Font registrations with family and either src or fonts. Font request options match renderer.

hyphenationCallback.note: Job-scoped named global hyphenation function. Omit for renderer default.

fontAction.note: Explicit font operation performed before generation. clear restores standard fonts before registering fonts.

fontDescriptors.note: Font descriptors for load or diagnostic getFont calls: fontFamily/fontWeight/fontStyle.

autoGenerate.note: Generate automatically when document or configuration changes. Default: true.

n_generate.note: Change this counter to generate manually, adapting usePDF update/pdf.updateContainer.

n_render.note: Read-only count of latest successful generations; adapts Document.onRender.

n_clicks.note: Read-only number of download anchor clicks.

loading.note: Read-only generation loading state, distinct from Dash callback loading.

url.note: Read-only current browser-local Blob URL; revoked on replacement or unmount.

returnBase64.note: Opt in to Base64 transmission to Python callbacks. Default: false.

fontFamilies.note: Read-only registered family names after generation.

fontInfo.note: Read-only serializable font-source diagnostics (no fontkit objects).
